inspirationLibrary.name: Open Image Prompts
inspirationLibrary.contentPolicy: Retrieve global and page-archetype complete local prompt records for the AI director only. Extract reusable camera, lighting, composition, material, depth, art direction and negative constraints; analyze every uploaded reference through a labelled contact sheet, keep the user prompt and product references binding, and expose only stable IDs, tags and blueprint counts to the panel.

lockLevels.label: 标准
lockLevels.instruction: Preserve the garment category, main color, print and overall silhouette. Minor styling adjustments are allowed only when they do not change product recognition.

lockLevels.label: 严格
lockLevels.instruction: Preserve the exact garment category, silhouette, cut, proportions, color, print, pattern, fabric appearance, neckline, sleeve length, closures, seams, pockets, hem and visible branding. Do not redesign the garment.

lockLevels.label: 完全锁定
lockLevels.instruction: Reproduce the product as faithfully as possible. Product identity overrides scene, pose and styling instructions. Keep every visible garment feature unchanged and only modify the explicitly requested environment, camera or masked region.

templates.label: 日系穿搭广告
templates.direction: Japanese womenswear lifestyle advertisement, Japanese woman age 25-35 wearing the product, natural confident pose, refined Tokyo editorial styling, layered real-world setting with depth, warm gray and muted green environment, premium but approachable ecommerce photography

templates.label: 非白底场景
templates.direction: Non-white lifestyle scene in a bright Japanese apartment, cafe terrace or quiet Tokyo street, visible furniture or architecture, foreground and background layers, natural lived-in details, realistic depth, the product remains the clear focal point

templates.label: 模特上身
templates.direction: Full-body or three-quarter model wearing the product, natural standing or walking pose, coordinated daily outfit visible from head to toe, accurate fit around waist, shoulders and hem, vertical Japanese catalog photography

templates.label: 模特换装/搭配
templates.direction: Create one coherent photorealistic full-body styling scene from the assigned references. Preserve the exact identity, face, hair, age impression, skin tone and body proportions from the person reference. Use every main-product image as an exact garment or wearable-product source; use bag, hat, shoes, jewelry, styling-accessory and explicitly named package/accessory references as exact item sources; use the scene reference as the requested environment. Follow filename-specific replacement and recolor instructions. Every input image is source-only: extract the assigned person or item, discard its original frame and non-selected background, and never show a reference as a separate tile, thumbnail, cutout card, inset or side-by-side panel. A cropped model may be completed naturally from head to toe when requested. Integrate garments and accessories with accurate fit, material, scale, perspective, occlusion and shadows. Preserve every unspecified attribute. Produce exactly one continuous single-camera photograph with one complete model, no advertising text, split screen, grid, collage, card, inset, logo or watermark.

templates.label: Rakuten 单张海报
templates.direction: Information-rich Japanese Rakuten fashion poster, large model with a complete product silhouette, layered editorial panels, restrained color swatches, measurement lines and benefit callouts, warm light-gray paper texture, limited vermilion and muted-gold accents

templates.label: 日本产品落地页 25图
templates.direction: Create exactly 25 Japanese ecommerce images at 1500x2000, 10 main images followed by 15 detail images. Local page slots validate product and selling-point coverage; they are not frozen photography recipes. First analyze all assigned product, detail, usage, person and style/layout references for exact product DNA, reference roles and Japanese copy. Then author one coordinated online photography plan for all 25 pages, with a shared palette and photographic grade, before writing the independent seven-layer page briefs. Preserve the complete source point, its stable source ID, documented color and construction, approved Japanese wording and every user-explicit scene, action, casting and exclusion. Within those boundaries let the AI choose camera, pose, environment, lighting, proof presentation and percentage layout. Use the full-suite narrative stage and shared shot manifest in every batch and split retry; a batch is not a new miniature campaign. Keep ordinary pages photograph-led, integrate evidence naturally and reserve comparisons or multi-region diagrams for their assigned purpose. Do not force local module positions, preset camera routes, a fixed number of person pages or decorative cards. Use realistic skin, simple category-correct gestures and physically accurate fabrics; show only reference-supported product views. Keep style references separate from product identity. Use only approved Japanese copy, or translate the exact current source point without changing its meaning. Generate and select a page-one photographic master before continuing with the remaining pages; use it for face, skin, white balance and photographic grade while original product references remain the only garment source. Preserve all existing product, source and language checks. Add no undocumented product detail, measurement, claim, institution, logo, price or border.

templates.label: Amazon A+专区
templates.direction: A coordinated nine-module Amazon Japan A+ product content set delivered as exact 970x600 horizontal assets. Compile each module from a compact reference-confirmed product contract, request a native 1536x1024 landscape base plate, then crop full-bleed to 970x600 and add the approved Japanese headline with a real local font. The image model must generate no letters, numerals, labels, pseudo-Japanese, fake glyphs, banners or typographic panels. First inspect the current product reference and prompt to identify the actual category, parts, materials, use method, benefits and specifications. For apparel, preserve exact color, silhouette, fabric, neckline, sleeve length, closure and button count, pocket count and placement, seams, panels and hem; prohibit unconfirmed rear views and invented construction. Use one clear selling point or proof format per module, generate module 1 as the visual master, then preserve exact product identity and photographic grade while rotating camera, pose, room zone, product scale and composition across modules 2-9. Cover product hero, core improvement, structure and work method, materials and performance, localized use, options and suitable users, specifications and compatibility, use and maintenance, then product-value close. Never show prices, promotions, reviews, ratings, competitor claims, Amazon logos or Amazon interface elements. 公司效果模式：产品与参考图分析完成后，针对每个模块执行独立二次摄影Brief（成片概念、焦段、机位、光线、证据与安全区），再交给Linkfox Skill编译；保留A+横版模块职责、无字底图和后期日文排版，不使用通用重复构图。

templates.label: 乐天专区
templates.direction: A coordinated nine-image text-free Rakuten Japan apparel commerce set made as exact 1500x1500 square assets: image 1 is a clean product-first thumbnail, images 2-7 each prove one apparel selling point through one continuous fashion photograph, and images 8-9 provide material and complete real-color proof. Every image is photography only: no headline, subtitle, slogan, label, callout, icon, arrow, measurement line, color name, badge, card, panel, decorative lettering or reserved copy zone, even if older cached metadata contains a headline. First inspect every uploaded product, detail and wearing reference to identify exact category, parts, materials, color, silhouette, fit and construction. Read supplied style references only for assigned pose, crop, light, scene atmosphere and information rhythm; the current uploaded product remains the only garment source. Use pale cool-gray studio pages plus uncluttered Japanese everyday scenes where assigned, broad soft daylight, realistic catalogue casting, varied full-body/medium/side/activity/detail/product-only shots and exact product consistency. Keep one model at most, realistic skin, exact product construction, varied pose fingerprints and no imported lace, crochet, mesh, camisole, jeans, bag, jewelry, logo or text from style references. Never fabricate prices, discounts, rankings, awards, reviews, sizes, material claims, Rakuten logos or interface elements; never add cards, panels, badges, borders or collages. 公司效果模式：产品与参考图分析完成后，针对每张方图执行独立二次摄影Brief（成片概念、焦段、机位、动作、裁切、光线与材质），再编译生图；保留乐天无字、无边框、单连续照片规则，不把风格参考中的服装或配饰迁移到产品。

templates.label: COD国家专区
templates.direction: A country-targeted COD landing-page set at 750x1000. Use the selected main/detail split: default 30 images are 8 main and 22 detail; 37 images are 15 main and 22 detail; honor a valid user-specified split. Every page's section controls its reference budget, copy density and image role. Analyze the product and all supplied references, preserve the full source-point ledger with exact original meaning, numbers, units and conditions, then create independent page briefs using the configured AI director. Do not cap explicit sources at five main plus ten secondary points or mark a truncated ledger complete. If page capacity is insufficient, report missing sources before rendering. Keep source-point identity, selected-country language, exact product and documented variants fixed. Calculate narrative stages against the full selected suite count even during split retries. Use distinct product-specific proof, local scenes and camera/action choices within each page's content contract. Preserve existing product fidelity, full-bleed canvas and brief/retry mechanisms. Do not invent product parts, offers, customer reviews, institutions, certificates, metrics or platform branding. Main-image density exception: keep one dominant core claim plus 3-5 distinct codMainSupportingPoints from approved current-product sources when available, with a separate headline/subheadline and 1-2 direct visual proof areas. Never count the main title as an auxiliary benefit. Carry all five approved support records through planning, rendering and review; a support area may contain several readable labels rather than one tiny callout. Primary source meaning stays intact; the approved supporting inventory is the only permitted addition from other source points. Detail pages, text-free/minimal requests, hooks and other suites keep their original content budgets. Never invent missing benefits or infer medical, certification or performance claims from appearance.

templates.label: COD详情图
templates.direction: A source-backed country-targeted COD detail suite at 750x1000, selectable at 12, 16, 20 or 22 images. Analyze product references and the complete brief, and allocate every explicit selling point before optional repeated overview or scene pages. Keep an identifiable product opener and product-information close; report any unassigned source before generation. Show a promotion opener only when the current brief supplies a valid exact discount and its conditions, preserving arbitrary valid percentages, maximum qualifiers, eligibility, quantities and stated dates. Otherwise use a regular product introduction, not a default discount badge. Use a customer-review page only for actual supplied review excerpts, preserving their count and meaning without invented filler, ratings or customer portraits. With no review text, use a product-use scene. Professional endorsement requires supplied supporting content; otherwise use observable product quality. The existing second AI director writes each page's scene, proof, action, camera, light and layout, while the literal source, product identity, country and actual page purpose remain binding. Coordinate stages against the actual complete suite count. Do not add missing prices, percentages, review text, customer metrics, institutions, certificates, parts or platform UI.

templates.label: COD噱头生图
templates.direction: Create a standalone country-targeted COD hook asset from the exact user prompt and assigned product references. Preserve product identity and one dominant intended benefit. Use the same textPolicy for text-only and reference-image requests: explicit text-free requirements override all modes; otherwise visible text is limited to explicitly requested headline/copy or the required supplied promotion, discount or price elements. Invent no missing offer, number, currency or deadline. The comparison type may use exactly two matched-condition panels; other hook types use one dominant continuous composition without unrelated panels. Localize people, environments and any approved copy to the selected market. Keep the requested canvas, exact documented variants, product fidelity and full-bleed design. Do not turn a hook into a suite or repeatedly pad it with unrelated benefit cards.

templates.label: FB 投放主图
templates.direction: Facebook and Instagram feed ad creative, immediate focal point, product benefit readable at first glance, strong subject-background separation, energetic asymmetric composition, room for optional copy overlay, conversion-focused fashion photography

templates.label: 商品细节
templates.direction: Premium ecommerce detail study, macro and medium close-up views of fabric texture, stitching, waist, neckline, sleeve, hem and construction, tactile material rendering on a warm light-gray textile surface

templates.label: 9:16封面
templates.direction: 9:16 Reels cover, dynamic centered fashion pose, visual movement in fabric and hair, clear face and garment, strong top-middle focal point, generous safe areas for later title overlay, mobile-first composition

templates.label: 参考图翻新
templates.direction: Refresh the supplied ecommerce photo into a current premium Japanese fashion campaign, improve environment, pose, lighting, depth and commercial polish while keeping the product exactly recognizable

templates.label: 局部换景
templates.direction: Repair or replace only the masked area according to the user intent, preserve the original product and all unmasked content, seamless photorealistic integration

templates.label: 多图搭配
templates.direction: Build one believable Japanese fashion advertising photograph from the supplied references, prioritize the exact product from image 1, then borrow only pose, scene and mood from the remaining images

global.materialAndLight: Photorealistic fabric texture, accurate folds and seams, soft directional daylight with controlled fill light, realistic skin, natural shadows, premium Japanese ecommerce color grading.
global.advertisingLayout: Clear visual hierarchy, complete garment silhouette, useful negative space, strong first-glance product recognition, polished commercial finish.
global.contentBudget: The AI director reads the complete user brief, assigns exactly one primary message and at most one directly supporting proof detail to each ordinary image, and keeps the product, model or result larger than all copy combined. Structured layouts are reserved for explicitly assigned comparison, process, feedback, size/specification and color-lineup pages.
global.negativeConstraints: No plain white background, no isolated floating product cutout, no generic empty studio, no product redesign, no changed color or pattern, no distorted anatomy, no extra fingers or limbs, no warped garment, no plastic skin, no random letters, no fake logo, no watermark, no frame or collage border.
